title: Unexplained room upgrade failure with `max() arg is an empty sequence`

labels.name: P4

body:
Internal users: https://sentry.matrix.org/sentry/synapse-matrixorg/issues/248863

```
StopIteration: {'$SKfkhwqUjfTruV99ydH_xDOSJpRxbs1z1KwB0dr4k5Y': EventCacheEntry(event=<FrozenEventV3 event_id=$SKfkhwqUjfTruV99ydH_xDOSJpRxbs1z1KwB0dr4k5Y, type=m.room.history_visibility, state_key=, outlier=True>, redacted_event=None), '$uVGqVzqiPxaazaB4u2A2qyMgKBN7sgH9UAOyZbsBFT8': EventCacheEntry(event=<FrozenEventV3 event_id=$uVGqVzqiPxaazaB4u2A2qyMgKBN7sgH9UAOyZbsBFT8, type=m.room.topic, state_key=, outlier=True>, redacted_event=None), '$PfPdbEHyuznWN1owZPmSKuOJIrVYAdLODXKcd5pf5SQ': EventCacheEntry(event=<FrozenEv...
  File "twisted/internet/defer.py", line 1660, in _inlineCallbacks
    result = current_context.run(gen.send, result)

ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence
  File "twisted/internet/defer.py", line 1660, in _inlineCallbacks
    result = current_context.run(gen.send, result)
  File "synapse/util/caches/response_cache.py", line 246, in cb
    return await callback(*args, **kwargs)
  File "synapse/handlers/room.py", line 270, in _upgrade_room
    tombstone_event_id=tombstone_event.event_id,
  File "synapse/handlers/room.py", line 500, in clone_existing_room
    state_default_int, ban, max(event_power_levels.values())
```


Inner call to `max()` here falls over if `event_power_levels` is an empty dict.

https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/blob/9cfecd2dc01e2e5c6ccb7b87f7beae83a98650f3/synapse/handlers/room.py#L486-L501

I noticed it in Sentry occuring on 1.58.0rc2, but oldest report is from 1.24.
